§lJoulesmith§r
A tech mod in three tiers: Basic, Reinforced and Advanced.

Every block's tooltip says what it does, and JEI shows every recipe and an info page for each machine.

§lGetting started§r
Mine tin, lead, silver, nickel and uranium. Smelt raw ore for ingots.

Build a Combustion Generator: it burns furnace fuel for power (FE). Join it to machines with Energy Cables.

§lMore from ore§r
Crusher: one raw ore makes two dusts.
Ore Washer (tier 2): three.
Chemical Dissolver and Crystallizer (tier 3): four.

Smelt dusts in an Electric Furnace.

§lTiers§r
A Basic Circuit opens tier 2 and an Advanced Circuit tier 3; both come from the Circuit Assembler.

Upgrade Kits raise cables, pipes, batteries, crates, bins, tanks and solar panels a tier where they stand.

§lMachines§r
Each has slide-out tabs: redstone mode, side settings (input, output, both, off) and upgrade slots for Speed, Efficiency, Bonus, Eject and Range cards.

Hover the red bar to see FE/t.

§lThe Wrench§r
Right-click a machine to turn it. Right-click a pipe or cable side to switch it between connected, push, pull and off.

Hold it to see each machine face's side setting in colour.

§lPipes§r
Item Ducts, Fluid Pipes and Energy Cables connect on their own. Set a side to pull to take from an inventory.

Put a Filter Card on a duct side to choose what passes: by item, tag or mod.

§lPower§r
Tier 1: Combustion Generator, Solar Panel.
Tier 2: Biofuel and Geothermal Generators.
Tier 3: Boiler and Steam Turbine, Wind Turbine.

Store it in Batteries.

§lRubber and plastic§r
Rubber trees grow in forests and jungles. Tap a log with a Tree Tap for latex; smelt it into rubber.

The Fluid Mixer makes plastic from Biofuel and latex, or from oil.

§lFarming§r
Planters, Harvesters and Tree Farms work the area in front of them. Sprinklers speed growth. Hydroponic Beds grow crops indoors.

The Mob Grinder stores XP as Liquid XP for the Auto Enchanter.

§lAutomation§r
Block Placer, Block Breaker, Autocrafter, Mechanical User, Quarry and Mob Fighter.

Sensors give redstone from what they read; a Logic Controller turns readings into signals.

§lPowered gear§r
The Power Drill, Chainsaw, Energy Sword and Exo-Suit run on FE instead of durability.

Charge them on a Charging Pad or by carrying an Energy Cell.

§lModules§r
At the Modification Table, fit two modules to a powered item: Fortune, Silk Touch, Range, Magnet, Jetpack, Night Vision, Lifesteal and more.

Each module's tooltip says what it fits.
